answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the mesa of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The ferrous lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tundra is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
